items.name: Avalo's own AI support
items.label: AVALO
items.desc: The chat window on this site and our LINE account run the same system we sell. Real production numbers: US$0.000116 per reply, about one NT cent per conversation, an 88.8% prompt cache hit rate — plus the two holes real conversations found after launch: it added a total up and got it wrong, and a customer left a phone number that notified nobody. Both fixes are now the default for every customer.
items.short: NT$0.011 a conversation, 88.8% cache hits, and the two things we got wrong.

items.name: REKAT ROASTERY
items.label: REKAT
items.desc: A brand site and online shop for a single-origin roastery in Taitung: a clickable SCA flavour wheel, a cherry cross-section that shows what each processing method removes, a roast curve marking first crack and development time, fifteen procedurally drawn bean illustrations, and a phone-friendly back office where the roaster marks a bean sold out himself — turning thirty years of judgement into something a customer can actually read.
items.short: Clickable flavor wheel, 15 program-drawn bean illustrations, sold-out toggled from a phone.

items.name: Monsieur Long
items.label: LONG
items.desc: A brand site for an artisan gelato shop in Taipei's Dadaocheng: oversized type with a melting motif, 16 procedurally drawn flavour illustrations, shared-element transitions from card to detail, and a phone-friendly back office where the shop ticks off today's flavours — change what's in the case, the site changes with it.
items.short: Melting hero type, 16 program-drawn gelato flavors, a daily-flavor admin.

items.name: Wenshan Lumber
items.label: WENSHAN
items.desc: A brand website for a three-generation lumber yard in Taipei: an interactive 3D log hero, a 12-category catalog in trade units, a venue picker guiding estimates, plus a quote list and freight/unit calculators — turning traditional expertise into business that starts online.
items.short: 3D timber hero, 12 lumber categories, board-foot and shipping calculators.

items.name: Finance Automation System
items.label: FIN
items.desc: A fully custom accounting system built from scratch: staff snap a photo of a receipt on Telegram and it's booked automatically, while the back office handles fixed-asset depreciation, FX, month-end close and P&L / balance-sheet reporting — fully governable and auditable. Not a template; a system grown around the client's own process.
items.short: Photograph a receipt in Telegram and it posts itself — through to depreciation and closing.

items.name: JeanToGo
items.label: JEAN
items.desc: A lead-gen + concierge platform for Uber Eats onboarding: SEO content and per-city landing pages bring in search traffic, an online form captures enquiries, a back-office CRM tracks every lead, and advisors handle the whole application through to going live — so non-technical owners get on board painlessly.
items.short: SEO landing pages per city, one-tap inquiry form, CRM tracking every lead.

items.name: GT Club Taiwan
items.label: GT
items.desc: A brand website and community platform for the association: an immersive experience with light/dark themes and motion, three topic hubs (AI / Web3 / sustainability), a works showcase, and one-tap join & newsletter conversion (validation + anti-spam + server-side landing + instant email), plus founder-count stats and visit analytics.
items.short: Light and dark immersive themes, three topic hubs, sign-up form and newsletter.

items.name: Damen KYT Anti-Fraud Platform
items.label: KYT
items.desc: A crypto anti-fraud & KYT (Know Your Transaction) platform: paste a wallet address for an instant risk score, file a report in 5 steps with an auto-generated PDF, plus blacklist/whitelist and a blockchain academy — live in Chinese and English.
items.short: Wallet risk scoring on the spot, plus a 5-step report flow that outputs a PDF.

items.type: Enterprise AI Knowledge Base · Fully Custom
items.name: AG Agent — Meeting Assistant
items.label: AG
items.desc: An internal AI meeting assistant: every week it auto-pulls reports and research from Google Drive, GPT produces structured highlights, Perplexity adds the latest news, and everything is vectorized for natural-language Q&A — with a dashboard, knowledge library and floating chatbot.
items.short: Weekly reports pulled automatically, summarized by GPT, vectorized and queryable.

items.name: Formula Kart — 3D Racing Game
items.label: KART
items.desc: An F1-style chibi 3D racing game that runs right in the browser: built with Three.js/WebGL, with 3 tracks, 9 cars, dynamic weather, drift & boost, 44 achievements, and up to 10-player real-time WebSocket racing — no install, no download.
items.short: Three.js 3D racing, dynamic weather, up to 10 players racing in real time.

sub.notFoundDesc: This link may be wrong or expired. Try the order lookup, or email service@avalokite.xyz.
sub.commitUntilPrepaid: {months} periods incl. the deposit already paid, charged until {date}
sub.taxNote: All amounts include tax and are charged monthly via ECPay
sub.pendingNote: This subscription hasn't been authorized yet, so care hasn't started. The first charge happens as soon as you authorize.
sub.notLiveHeading: Site not live yet — billing hasn’t started
sub.notLiveNote: Your site is still in production. Monthly care is billed only once the site is live and you've accepted it, so there's nothing to pay and nothing to do here yet. We'll email you the authorization link when it goes live, and your seat deposit will be credited in full to the first month.
sub.cancelledNote: This subscription has been cancelled and will not be charged again. To restart care, place a new order or email service@avalokite.xyz.
sub.replacedNote: This subscription was replaced by a newer plan. Use the management link in your most recent email.
sub.changeNote: ECPay's recurring payments can't change amount, so changing plans means cancelling the current authorization and authorizing the new plan once. The new plan's first charge happens at authorization — you won't be double-charged.
sub.changeConfirm: Change plan? The current authorization will be cancelled, then you'll be taken to ECPay to authorize the new one.
sub.cardNote: Use this when a charge fails because your card expired or changed. ECPay can't swap the card on an existing authorization — the old one is cancelled and you authorize once with the new card.
sub.cardConfirm: Re-authorize? The current authorization will be cancelled, then you'll be taken to ECPay to authorize with your new card.
sub.cancelNote: No further charges after cancelling; the period you've already paid runs to its end. Hosting, backups, security updates and monitoring stop after that.
sub.cancelCommitted: Your plan is still within its minimum term. Zero Setup spreads the standard NT$39,000 build fee across 24 months, so leaving early means settling the unamortized part (see the amount above). Email us first — most situations can be worked out.
sub.cancelConfirm: Cancel the subscription? ECPay cannot restart it — a new order would be required.
sub.cancelled: Your subscription is cancelled. No further charges will be made and a confirmation email is on its way.
sub.errEcpay: ECPay reported a failure while cancelling. Please email service@avalokite.xyz and we will handle it manually.
sub.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please retry or email service@avalokite.xyz.
sub.help: Questions? Email service@avalokite.xyz and we will reply within one business day.
